introduction: Oklahoma’s Human Services page links the MyWAP online application for weatherization. The administering provider must confirm current home eligibility and scheduling.
description: Oklahoma’s Human Services page links the MyWAP online application for weatherization. The administering provider must confirm current home eligibility and scheduling.

sections.who: The state describes weatherization for low-income households. Detailed current provider eligibility rules require confirmation.
sections.get: Approved work uses weatherization measures and household education to reduce energy costs.
sections.docs:
• Household income information.
  • Home address and energy accounts.
  • Property-owner details and any consent the provider requests.
sections.apply:
1. Use the state-linked application

    Follow the weatherization link on Human Services’ energy page.

  2. Confirm the local provider

    Ask which agency serves your home and obtain its current checklist.

  3. Arrange assessment

    Discuss access, permissions and any waiting list before expecting work.
sections.after: Keep application records and ask the provider what an assessment or scheduling decision means for your home.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using State-confirmed weatherization purpose and application link, Commerce program page. USA Assistance background guide. The linked provider must confirm current eligibility and intake arrangements.

faqs: Is this the ordinary energy-bill application?
The state lists a separate MyWAP application for weatherization.
Human Services identifies the Department of Commerce as its weatherization partner.
No. Confirm eligibility, assessment and scheduling directly with the provider.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
blockers: Human Services confirms program purpose and MyWAP route, but Commerce program page inaccessible; current detailed local home eligibility and assessment rules need provider confirmation.
